verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms an llms.txt is served at docs.stagehand.dev/llms.txt (HTTP 200) and indexes markdown versions of doc pages. The docs also include a dedicated AI-rules page of configs and snippets for coding assistants, and individual pages are available as .md for agent consumption. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of agents actually working from these docs, and no evidence of an llms-full.txt or similar full-content bundle.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.stagehand.dev/llms.txt # Stagehand
This page collects the rules, configs, and copy-paste snippets that get your coding assistant writing correct Stagehand v4 code.
